svg.text: Download and import the official appliance
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Physical host → official Wazuh documentation → VMware Workstation Pro
Open the linked Wazuh VMware appliance instructions. Download the current supported OVA and
compare its published hash. Use a release package, not an unverified tutorial download.
In Workstation choose File → Open, select the OVA, name the imported VM SEC-MON01 and choose a
local storage folder with sufficient free space. Review the documented 4-core/8-GB/50-GB
Attach it to the same approved private/NAT lab VMnet as your practice endpoints. Do not bridge
it onto a workplace network or publish its dashboard to the internet.
Check: The appliance is imported on the intended private network.
